finance.scopeNote: TripOS maintains two separate group-account ledgers. The historical six-person pool remains closed and auditable; the active eight-person account has its own cash, charges and payables. Inter-account money is represented only by explicit linked receivable/payable records. Vyas Devgna covers all Milan trip costs, but those are personal Milan → Vyas liabilities and do not merge either group account.

interAccountLinks.note: The old six-person pool physically paid ₹200 for one taxi belonging to the active eight-person account. Old pool carries a ₹200 receivable and active pool carries a matching ₹200 payable until reimbursement.

memberCoveragePolicies.note: Vyas Devgna is covering all of Milan's Mumbai-trip costs. The current known Milan → Vyas liability is ₹3,778.75. Future Milan costs paid or fronted by Vyas must be appended to this breakdown and added to the trip-end liability, without changing either group's cash unless that specific transaction belongs to a group account. Shared active-group expenses funded from cash already contributed for Milan must not be added again as a separate Milan liability.
